title: Transfer fixed-radix parsing to Guava unsigned words
description: Check the released Guava 33.4.8-jre UnsignedInts parser for every 32-bit word in upper- and lowercase hexadecimal and both unsigned range failures. Require original-JVM replay for the deliberately false sign theorem, retain staged and stock JBMC on matching callers, and measure their post-call reach controls.
expected: Record all three native and comparator verdicts, timings, assertion identifiers and replay checks on the original Guava JARs.

resources.notes: Three predicates and their stock reach controls use the campaign's 120-second per-checker budget; the native parser has a fixed eight-digit input.

steps.name: Check the released Guava parser on all three engines
